hero.title: HashiCorp Certifications
hero.description: Each certification program tests both conceptual knowledge and real-world experience using HashiCorp multi-cloud tools. Upon passing the exam, you can easily communicate your proficiency and employers can quickly verify your results.

announcement.heading: TechXchange is Coming
announcement.text: Learn from certified instructors on how to boost your enterprise adoption of HashiCorp

certificationPrograms.containerDescription: We offer Terraform certifications at three levels. Earn the Terraform Associate certification to validate your foundational Terraform knowledge and skills. Demonstrate your professional experience using Terraform with the Terraform Infrastructure Engineer certification, and prove your advanced production experience with the lab-based Terraform Authoring and Operations Advanced certification.

Earn an associate-level certification to validate your foundational Vault or Consul knowledge and skills. You can also demonstrate your product-ready Vault operational experience when you pass the Vault Operations Advanced exam.
